purpose: Pin the public code/data inputs for reproducing the light-ring source-region decomposition and independently varying the source mask and QNM filter. This manifest is not a run receipt or physical result.

upstream.paper: How much of the black hole ringdown is sourced within the light ring?

supersedes.note: Version 1; do not silently substitute it for the v2 reproduction inputs.

zenodo.checksum_policy: The record publishes MD5 values. These are retained only as upstream identifiers. Recompute SHA-256 from downloaded bytes and bind the resulting values in an execution receipt before use.

reproduction_tiers.expected_scope: Rebuild the paper waveform panel and SNR waveform calculation together with tables, convergence figures and non-waveform-paper outputs.
Re-run the complete reduction over the unreduced production-grid records.
reproduction_tiers.resource_note: The upstream README reports approximately 1080 core-hours for the original full production grid. Re-running it is not required merely to regenerate outputs already shipped in the reduced/paper-specific bundles.

mathematical_and_unit_conventions.observable: Asymptotic waveform readout at future null infinity, parameterized by retarded time u; the paper projects onto the (2,2,0) spheroidal harmonic.

mass_units.requirement: Convert every radius, time, frequency and waveform normalization to one explicitly declared M convention before any cross-script or cross-engine comparison.

mathematical_and_unit_conventions.unit_status: Upstream convention transcribed; local code/data bytes and outputs have not been independently verified.

production_grid.note: The README describes two plunge-angular-momentum choices per spin except the chi=0.95 subset. Exact record-to-parameter mapping must be read from the shipped metadata; this manifest does not invent missing per-record identifiers.

additional_data_scope.description: The README identifies paper-specific order-8 data for chi=0.7 and plunge angular momentum 1.0, including full/in/out and inside/outside waveforms for mask-width ablations at f=0.5 and f=1.0.
additional_data_scope.caveat: Do not assume the wider-mask variants are populated for every one of the 63 production configurations.

source_mask.reported_filter_interaction: For the wider f=0.5 and f=1.0 masks, the upstream README says the de-spike filter finds no high-frequency band to remove; the filtered inside contribution is shown without that removal.

required_interventions.rule: Vary the source mask and QNM/de-spike filter independently wherever the pinned data support the factorial comparison. Preserve missing combinations as unavailable; do not fill them by interpolation or assume complete factorial coverage.

detector_snr.upstream_method: Point-particle plunge waveform rescaled to the GW250114 remnant mass and aligned to the maximum-likelihood (2,2) mode peak.
detector_snr.limitation: The README explicitly cautions that the point-particle plunge is not a comparable-mass merger. Resulting SNRs are estimates, not a direct detector-bound measurement of generic comparable-mass source-region emission.

claim_ceiling: A reproduction can establish that the declared code and shipped data regenerate the specified source-mask/filter outputs.
It does not establish that the inside-light-ring source component is a universal bound for comparable-mass mergers.
A filtered residual is not identical to the physical source contribution inside the light ring.
The detector SNR rescaling remains conditional on the point-particle plunge model.
No claim about horizon emission, surface gravity or horizon reflectivity follows from this source-region manifest alone.
provenance_requirements_for_future_run: SHA-256 for every downloaded archive and extracted input file
Exact archive version and README digest
Python 3.11.14 and pinned upstream lock/environment identity for compatibility reproduction
Exact upstream code revision where recoverable
Per-case IDs and mass/spin/plunge parameters from upstream metadata
Machine-readable outputs for each mask/filter/resolution/source segment
Independent reproduction receipt and categorized negative-control results

integration.use_existing_pinned_data: Prefer the shipped reduced/paper-specific data for baseline reproduction; reserve full raw-grid reduction for targeted independent checks.
